SocialErasmus+ is an international project by the Erasmus Student Network (ESN) that promotes a social attitude among young citizens participating in mobility programs, to facilitate their integration into the local community while gives them the chance to make a long-lasting social change in society through volunteering activities. The project goes under the slogan: Leave your mark!
You will sign a contract with SiA Housing, and are personally responsible for the monthly payments and termination of contract.
